values.label: Core values that guide our work

items.label: Ownership, not outsourcing
items.description: We treat your product as if it were ours – taking responsibility for decisions, not just tickets.

items.label: Clarity over complexity
items.description: Simple, well-structured solutions, readable code, and documentation that future teams can follow.

items.label: Long-term thinking
items.description: Choices around stack, architecture, and releases are made with the next 3–5 years in mind.

items.label: Honest communication
items.description: We surface risks early, give realistic estimates, and prefer honest updates over surprises.

howwework.title: A simple, transparent process from first call to long-term support.
howwework.intro: We keep the steps clear so you always know what we are doing, why, and what's next. No heavy bureaucracy – just a structured way of working that fits busy product teams.

steps.label: Discovery & fit
steps.description: Short calls to understand your product, constraints, and priorities. We confirm if QalbIT is the right partner and suggest a practical starting point.

steps.label: Scope, plan & proposal
steps.description: We outline scope, tech choices, milestones, and timelines – with clear estimates for either fixed-scope delivery or a dedicated team model.

steps.label: Build in focused sprints
steps.description: Design, development, and QA move in small, reviewable increments. You get regular demos, changelogs, and a clear view of progress.

steps.label: Launch, handover & support
steps.description: We help with go-live, monitoring, and documentation. After launch, we can continue as your product team for new features and maintenance.

howwework.reassurance: Typical engagements run from a few weeks (MVPs) to multi-quarter roadmaps for growing SaaS products.

casestudy.title: Selected case studies & product outcomes.
casestudy.intro: A few examples of how QalbIT helps teams ship and scale SaaS and custom software products.

items.title: Snappy Stats – scheduling management web app for a growing shooting academy.
items.description: We replaced spreadsheets and manual coordination with a Laravel-based scheduling platform that centralises bookings, coaches and lanes – dramatically reducing double bookings and admin fire-fighting.

details.label: Outcome
details.value: Single source of truth for classes & lanes

items.title: Bloomford – hiring portal and candidate management platform for HR professionals.
items.description: We designed and built a PHP/MySQL recruitment portal that centralises employers, vacancies and candidates, turning scattered CVs and inboxes into one searchable talent pipeline for HR teams in Belgium.

items.title: Hellory – smart reminder app for busy lives on Android & iOS.
items.description: We partnered with the Hellory team to build a cross-platform Flutter app and Node.js API that power recurring reminders, templates and reliable notifications for users managing bills, events and daily routines.

casestudy.footnote: We can share more detailed case studies, metrics, and references once we understand your product and requirements.
